<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="p">
  <state id="p" initial="c">
    <history id="h">
      <transition cond="true" target="c"/>
    </history>
    <state id="c">
      <transition event="go" target="d"/>
    </state>
    <final id="d"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

notes: the history default is unconditional: SCXML 3.10.2 says the history transition "MUST NOT contain 'cond' or 'event' attributes" and must name a target
